summary:
Shopify is the commerce platform at shopify.com. Merchants look up the bag icon for the admin and the marketing site. A shop’s own storefront favicon is a different file and is not copied here.

Checked 12 November 2026 against shopify.com. HTML came from https://www.shopify.com/ (HTTP 200).
